name: Dawn * Slave 2 ~Aka no Setsuna Shiro no Toki~
source:
The stage is Manchukuo-era Qiqihar in the 1930s. The protagonist, Kamuriki Shigeaki, is ordered by his foster father, Hiroto, to train a former Russian noblewoman Olga and her daughter Tatiana. Though he has handled the training of women many times before, he begins to develop unfamiliar feelings toward this pair. Interwoven with interactions involving the maid Rosetta and the cook Rui Rui, Shigeaki carries out their training over three months.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/ds2/ds2.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
舞台是20世纪30年代满洲国时期的齐齐哈尔。主角神力重明受养父博人命令，训练前俄罗斯贵族奥尔加和她的女儿塔季扬娜。尽管他过去多次训练女性，却开始对这对母女产生陌生情感。在与女仆罗塞塔和厨师蕊蕊的互动交织下，重明在三个月内完成训练。

[译自[url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/ds2/ds2.html]官方网站[/url]]
